name: @wbniv/bsnes-jg-player
description: In-browser SNES player: a reproducible Emscripten build of bsnes-jg 2.1.0 (no libretro, no EmulatorJS) with a canvas front-end, keyboard pad, fullscreen, manifest-driven touch nav, and an in-page fidelity self-check. Ships a sync CLI, a framework-agnostic embed, and an Astro component.
author: Will Norris

scripts.test: node bin/sync.mjs sync /tmp/bsnes-jg-player-smoke --demo && node bin/sync.mjs sync --check /tmp/bsnes-jg-player-smoke && rm -rf /tmp/bsnes-jg-player-smoke && node scripts/check-picker-roms.mjs
